The test image shows a corn **leaf** with:
- Multiple small, scattered dark green spots across the leaf surface
- One prominent white/light-colored circular spot (appears dried/necrotic center)
- Spots appear random across the leaf, small in size (~pencil eraser)

This pattern matches **Holcus_Spot** (circular spots drying to white/tan with random distribution) or **Eyespot** (small circular spots with halos). Let me view one reference to confirm.

The reference Holcus_Spot image shows a white to pinkish oval spot on a green leaf — closely matching the prominent white circular lesion in the test image. The test image also has multiple smaller dark green water-soaked spots (early stage), consistent with the Holcus Spot description of "dark green water-soaked spots that dry to light tan or white."
